title: critical-areas.json
description: The high-risk areas canary-critical-areas writes to .canary/critical-areas.json and canary-katana alarms on. Not a canary.* layer: the file carries no contract field. Unknown fields are tolerated. Rules the subset cannot express (a non-empty symbols list, a symbol with something to match) live in critical-areas.mjs.

symbols.$comment: Optional (#1242). The names a test title must contain to count as covering this area, matched case-insensitively on letters and digits. Replaces the path basename, which is too generic to match on for areas like engine.ts or rules.ts.
